env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A const declaration folded at compile time is cut at the closing bracket
# of its own initializer. A block comment or a line break in any gap of the
# initializer, before its closing bracket, or between the callee and its
# parentheses changes nothing: the module runs natively, ejects, and the
# ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272
# and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^9 16 nm nm nm \[1 2 3\] \[3 4 7\] \[5 6 11\]$'
stdout '^25 \[6 7 13\] nm \[8 9 17\]$'
stdout '^36 \[1 2 3\] 49 \[8 9 17\] nm \[4 5 9\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constdeclboundary

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

const func sq(x int) int { return x * x }
const func pair(a, b int) []int { return []int{a, b, a + b} }
const func name() string { return "nm" }

const A = sq( /*c*/ 3 /*c*/ ) /*c*/
const B = sq(
	4,
)
const C = name( /*c*/ ) /*c*/
const D = name /*c*/ ( /*c*/ ) /*c*/
const E = name(
)
const F = pair(1, 2 /*c*/) /*c*/
const G = pair /*c*/ ( /*c*/ 3 /*c*/ , /*c*/ 4 /*c*/ ) /*c*/
const H = pair(
	5,
	6,
)

const (
	GA = sq( /*c*/ 5 /*c*/ ) /*c*/ // line
	GB = pair(6 /*c*/, 7 /*c*/) /*c*/
	GC = name /*c*/ ( /*c*/ ) /*c*/
	GD = pair(
		8,
		9,
	)
)

func main() {
	const L1 = sq( /*c*/ 6 /*c*/ ) /*c*/
	const L2 = pair(1, 2 /*c*/) /*c*/
	const (
		L3 = sq(7 /*c*/) /*c*/
		L4 = pair(8, /*c*/ 9 /*c*/) /*c*/
		L5 = name( /*c*/ ) /*c*/
		L6 = pair(
			4,
			5,
		)
	)
	fmt.Println(A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H)
	fmt.Println(GA, GB, GC, GD)
	fmt.Println(L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6)
}
